brief: The lane is the busiest and nearest strip in the town and it takes NO building shadow at any hour: #140 measured ROAD.lane at 0.0%. #146 found the reason - sunVec()'s ly is 0.58..0.32, northward at every hour of every season, and every tall caster in this town stands at the world's NORTH edge, so the throws leave the map. The one volume SOUTH of the lane is our own block, and eaveFor() returns 0 for every y >= LN_WALK_S. Read the comment at that line: it is a DRAWING constraint (project() lifts z northward, so our block at its true eave would be drawn standing in front of the lane, which is what the picture is looking at), and shTop[] reads it as though it were a fact about the building. #146's towerShTop() is the precedent for a casting height that is NOT the drawn eave - do the same for the near block, so that our own terrace throws a real morning and evening shadow north across the lane. Price the reachable ground BEFORE you raise the caster and report what you found: unlike the towers, this one has thirteen rows of open roadway and pavement downwind of it.
successLooksLike: On a fair morning and again in the evening a band of shade lies across the lane's roadway and footway and slides east-to-west across the day, retreating under the parapet toward noon; road-surface.mjs moves ROAD.lane off 0.0%; the courtyard, plaza and river framings are unchanged.
avoid: The occlusion walk and the casting height are TWO heights and conflating them is how this brief fails. buildShadowGrid's second loop uses cover = min(cover, y - shTop[i]*LIFT) to veto cells hidden BEHIND a volume on screen; if you feed that walk the new casting height it will clear shOpen off the near half of the lane and DELETE shade instead of adding it. Feed the occlusion walk our block's DRAWN height (eave 0, ridge 2.11) and the cast the new one. Do not invent a storey height: solve it from what drawNearRoof actually draws, or from eaveBand's own terrace value, and state in the entry which you used and why. Do not change the near roof's draw, its parapet or nearShadow(). A northward throw must still be vetoed per column or it paints the caster's own roof.
